fields.statement: Verifier at d5c74fb19: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/ciworkflow/... -v passes (go vet clean, bash -n on the script clean). TestChangesScript runs .github/scripts/ci-changes.sh BASE [GREEN] against scratch git repos (no network) and asserts code=false for a land-like .rhiza/-only commit after green and for a merge of main bringing only .rhiza/, code=true for a code change since green, for a merge of main bringing code, and with no green commit when the PR diff from base leaves .rhiza/ (plus code=false when it stays in .rhiza/). TestCIChangesDecidesFromGitDiff asserts the changes job runs .github/scripts/ci-changes.sh fed steps.green.outputs.sha, and TestCICheckAggregatesEveryJob still passes on the check job. Read the diff: the green step lists the PR's commits newest first via gh api with the job's github.token, head excluded, and takes the first whose check run named check concluded success; a green that is not an ancestor of HEAD falls back to the merge base. Note: ci.yml declares no permissions block, so the gh api reads rely on the repo's default token permissions (fine for a public repo); and since HEAD is the PR merge commit, an advanced main makes the diff conservative (code=true), never unsafe.
